events.title: Jennifer Lopez turns 57
events.blurb: Today, multi-talented global superstar Jennifer Lopez celebrates her 57th birthday.

angles.name: J.Lo Birthday Bash
angles.copy: Happy 57th birthday to the one and only J.Lo! We're turning up the heat with her biggest hits all day. What's your favourite J.Lo track?

events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: The legendary frontman of The Rolling Stones, Mick Jagger, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Stones Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young and still got the moves! Happy birthday to the iconic Mick Jagger. What's your ultimate Rolling Stones anthem?

events.title: MTV launched 45 years ago
events.blurb: On this day in 1981, MTV launched, forever changing the music landscape with its first video, The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star'.

angles.name: MTV's Big Birthday
angles.copy: 45 years ago today, MTV hit our screens and changed music forever! Remember The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' kicking it all off? What was the first music video that blew your mind?

events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their seminal debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on this day in 1994, launching them into superstardom.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Anniversary
angles.copy: 32 years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed British music. Which track from that album still gives you chills?

events.title: Woodstock Festival's 57th Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Remembering Woodstock
angles.copy: 57 years ago, half a million people gathered for three days of peace and music at Woodstock. Imagine being there! What's your favourite iconic Woodstock performance?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley, would have been 91
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the King today. Elvis Presley's music continues to define generations, and he would have been 91. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur, would have been 55
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 years old.

angles.name: Tupac's Enduring Impact
angles.copy: Remembering the legend, Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 today. His words and music continue to resonate. What's your favourite Tupac lyric?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix, would have been 84
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of guitar icon Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84.

angles.name: Hendrix's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84 today. His guitar changed everything. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969, featuring that unforgettable zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in history! What's your go-to track from the record?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The formidable lead singer of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the rock 'n' roll legend, Chrissie Hynde! Still sounding incredible. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The iconic Oasis frontman, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad Fer It Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released 51 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975, spreading a message of peace and hope.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: 51 years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. A song that's as powerful and relevant today as it was then. What does this iconic track mean to you?

events.title: First iPod released 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod's Quarter Century
angles.copy: Remember your first iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple dropped the original, changing music on the go forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: It's James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic British secret agent and the enduring film franchise.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Time to rewatch your favourite 007 flick or blast some classic Bond themes. Who's your ultimate Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today we celebrate the birthday of The Beatles' legend John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message of peace live on. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy icon. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sprawling double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album'. A masterpiece of diverse sounds. What's your hidden gem track from this iconic record?
